notes: Tuition fees: the DAAD page says "Tuition fees per semester None", but this is the general DAAD entry for the programme and the H-BRS fee pages say the semester contribution is the only fee for state-university Bachelor's programmes. Because the fee statement is institution-wide and not specific to non-EU applicants for this programme, no tuition fact is included. The application deadline "15 May - 15 July" is stated for "applicants from: all countries" without a year, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline. Language test list: only tests explicitly named (IELTS, TOEFL, PTE); other quoted qualifications (telc, Cambridge B2 First) are not in the acceptedTests list.

note.fr: Vérifier les conditions d'accès : diplôme étranger reconnu équivalent, et procédure via uni-assist pour les candidats avec certificats internationaux.
note.en: Check admission requirements: recognised equivalent foreign qualification, and uni-assist procedure for applicants with international certificates.

evidence.quote: General or subject-related higher education entrance qualification (Abitur, Fachabitur) or educational qualifications recognised as equivalent by the relevant authorities.
For applicants with international certificates or with assessment tests ("Feststellungsprüfung") from preparatory courses ("Studienkolleg") application is possible exclusively via uni-assist.
